1.1.0: The spectrum comes back to the desktop widgets: their Prism light splits into its colours
A cleaner mark: one solid prism lit by the spectrum, in the Dock and wherever iRiS shows its mark
The Island at rest: the hour over a short line of the spectrum that opens under the pointer
Smoked glass: panels and widgets keep Prism's near-black over any wallpaper
1.0.2: Glass stays your choice: Prism no longer makes every body solid
1.0.1: No rim round panels and cards: each one stands off by its fill
Settings areas keep their marks instead of numbers, and Spotlight results lose their numbers
1.0.0: The whole shell in Prism's language: the near-black of Prism Settings, white solids, round marks and hairlines of light, quick to move
Black that is never flat: each panel takes a soft haze of the spectrum from one corner
Controls of their own: ON and OFF written on the switch, white levels with the spectrum at their head, lit tiles in solid white
The Island at rest: a thread of white light meets the hour and leaves it as the spectrum
Desktop widgets wear their Prism faces while it is on

summary: iRiS in Prism's language: smoked near-black, white solids and the spectrum
description: A Design for iRiS that dresses the whole shell in the language of Prism, iRiS's Settings: the three near-black neutrals and Apple's label inks, white solids for what is chosen, round marks, bodies that stand off by their fill and quick motion. Its glass keeps a smoked near-black over any wallpaper. At rest the Island shows the hour over a short line of the spectrum. Desktop widgets wear their Prism faces, their light split into the spectrum; your accent still marks where you are.
